scope: debug-client visual-only high-city block layout refinement
purpose: Refine the accepted experimental high-city block into a clearer visual city-block layout while remaining debug-client visual-only.

layout_intent.center: public meeting plaza with fountain, notice board, benches, and banners

route_hierarchy: gate -> plaza -> market / house / castle -> sewer hint
refinements_attempted: Reduced dense debug-collage feel by separating house, market, castle, plaza, and sewer zones.
Created a clearer gate-to-plaza path using central floor/path emphasis.
Moved house cluster to lower-left and market lane to upper/right.
Used faded/hidden overlays in focused routes to reduce roof/building mass dominance.
Placed sewer hint on the lower-right edge as a distinct undercity cue.
Retained canvas-only captures for cleaner review evidence.

minor_visual_notes: Large cobble areas still have heavy tile repetition.
Gate-to-plaza route is readable but could later be emphasized with clearer path treatment.
Sewer corner is readable but could use a stronger landmark or darker ground treatment.
Central fountain/plaza area may benefit from slightly more breathing room in a later art pass.
Recheck z-order after any future spacing or object-placement changes.

non_claims: This is not a production map promotion.

This does not add map object metadata, collision, walkability, ownership, access lists, lock state, door permissions, house entry, dialogue, shops, factions, spawns, AI, combat, NPC behavior, or mob behavior.
This does not add protocol fields or shared map JSON changes.
This accepts the refined block as a visual layout candidate with minor visual notes, not as a final production city layout.
notes: The refined block is assembled from debug-client review fixtures and existing visual-only source assets.
Review routes are deterministic and remain separate from shared production map JSON.
The next gate can proceed as a design gate for map/object metadata separation; production map promotion remains out of scope.
